name: Kendo-Seedance 2.5+Qwen
readme:
# Kendo-Seedance 2.5+Qwen

Studio v3.1.0-studio.2: Seedance video only. Local Qwen image generation is paused.

- **Page HTML:** port 3000, /seedance25.html. Old /images.html links redirect to video.
- **Comfy MCP:** port 3001. One access-code URL includes both ComfyUI and KIE tools. The code is generated at first boot and retained on the volume. Local Qwen MCP generation is disabled.
- **ComfyUI:** port 8188. **JupyterLab:** port 8888.

Set KIE_API_KEY in the Pod environment before launch. Select Seedance 2.5 or regular Seedance 2.0. Start with 3 attachment slots and add one at a time, up to 30 references for Seedance 2.5 or 9 for Seedance 2.0. Review the estimated price and confirm before submitting a paid job.

Qwen models are no longer downloaded automatically. Existing model files and ComfyUI are retained. Container disk and persistent volume default to 100 GB each; a Network Volume has its own size.

See https://github.com/mamypoko2008/kendo-comfyui-h3/blob/main/STUDIO.md for release details.
